accessPolicy.note: The WHO landing page's generic copyright link resolves to CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO, but the source-specific copyright notice on page iv of the official PDF states CC BY-NC-ND 3.0 IGO and expressly prohibits adaptations, including translations, without WHO permission. The source-specific notice controls this project decision. PsychSim records metadata only and does not extract, summarize with AI, or convert CDDR text into rules pending written permission. The separately licensed ICD-11 API/digital classification is also NoDerivatives.
